title: Pertamina Eco RunFest 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Pertamina Eco RunFest 2026 Review | GBK, Jakarta
meta_description: Pertamina Eco RunFest review: 14,000 runners at GBK on 23 November 2025, a new World Athletics Road Race Label, and a fully carbon-offset event.
dek: Pertamina's Jakarta race drew 14,000 runners to Gelora Bung Karno in November 2025, its second year, and earned a World Athletics label. Here is what that edition was like.
verdict: Pertamina Eco RunFest is a big Jakarta race built around sustainability. The 2025 edition, its second, on 23 November at Gelora Bung Karno and Istora Senayan, drew 14,000 runners [1]. Most ran the shorter distances: 6,300 in the 5 km, 3,800 in the 10 km, 2,200 in a 1.5 km family run and 1,700 in the half marathon [1]. It was verified as a World Athletics Road Race Label event in 2025, and Pertamina said every emission from runners, stage and festival was fully offset [1]. If you want a large, family-friendly race in central Jakarta with a certified half marathon, it is a good choice.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The race was held on 23 November 2025 at Gelora Bung Karno and Istora Senayan in Jakarta, and drew 14,000 runners [1]. It was the event's second year [1].
The field was weighted towards the shorter distances: 6,300 in the 5 km fun run, 3,800 in the 10 km, 2,200 in the 1.5 km family category and 1,700 in the 21 km half marathon [1].

sections.heading: A Label and a Carbon Claim
paragraphs: Pertamina's president director, Simon Aloysius Mantiri, said the race had been verified as a World Athletics Road Race Label event in 2025 [1].

The company described it as the first carbon-free edition: all emissions from runners, the entertainment stage and festival activities were offset through Pertamina's carbon offset programme, and all waste was to be recycled into useful products [1]. The 2024 edition had been billed as Indonesia's first carbon-neutral run [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a big, well-backed race in central Jakarta, especially over the shorter distances, or a certified half marathon without the crowds of the 5 km.
The carbon claims are the company's own; take them as its description of the event rather than an independent audit.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran Pertamina Eco RunFest in 2025?
faqs.answer: 14,000 runners took part on 23 November 2025 at Gelora Bung Karno and Istora Senayan, Jakarta: 6,300 in the 5 km, 3,800 in the 10 km, 2,200 in the 1.5 km family run and 1,700 in the half marathon.

faqs.question: Is Pertamina Eco RunFest a World Athletics race?
faqs.answer: Yes. In 2025 it was verified as a World Athletics Road Race Label event, in its second year. The label applies to the certified course and race standards.

faqs.question: Is Pertamina Eco RunFest carbon neutral?
faqs.answer: Pertamina says so. It described the 2025 edition as carbon-free, with all emissions from runners, stage and festival offset through its carbon programme, and all waste recycled. These are the company's own claims.
